{{Quote|If you break the Law of Life, we will no longer be able to tolerate your touch.|translated=1|The bafforr, to Momaw Nadon|<ref name="TFMEC" />}}
A '''grove of bafforr trees''' grew on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], in one of the many side domes of the [[Momaw Nadon's house|home]] of [[Momaw Nadon/Legends|Momaw Nadon]], an exiled [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] priest. The grove forbid Nadon from [[Death/Legends|killing]] the Imperial [[Alima]].<ref name="TFMEC" />
